header.name: Digital Ethnography Research Methods (DERM)
header.description: This course is intended to be an advanced course on digital ethnography. The course explore issues involved in conducting qualitative ethnographic research in the social sciences in the digital space. It begins with the fundamentals of Ethnography as a research method. It then moves to approaches, strategies and techniques for conducting research which engage directly with online and digital environments, including social media platforms, blogs and discussions forums and immersive digital realms such as virtual worlds. The course will use a combination of lectures and case studies to showcase how Digital Ethnography opens up novel areas for research.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: The course will be able to help learners in assessing broad scenarios of human engagement with technology, where DERM will be applicable as a research method.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: The course will help learners to critically appraise the uses of data and its limits. It will help analyse, compare and contrast arenas of data proliferation, data asymmetry and data absence of data. Learners will then be able to apply to small but thick data and use it to complement the big data analytics approach.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: The learner will be able to evaluate research themes and issues – ethical, practical and conceptual – involved in conducting research in digitally-mediated environments and/or research utilising digital research methods

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: The learner is able to design a digital ethnographic research using the strategies, methods and tools transacted in the course and come up with a digital ethnographic and qualitative research project in the social sciences, with particular reference to digital and online environments in their own research

lecture_topics: Why Ethnography for a Digital World? (Method/Research Field)
Ethnographic Exploration in Digitally Mediated Environment
Research Design - Strategies for discerning the Everyday Digital
Other Data Collection Methods for Digital Ethnographic Research
